content.short: Spacetime Meta is a user-owned virtual universe on Cardano where creators build and manage digital planets.
content.description: Spacetime Meta is an ambitious metaverse project built on the Cardano blockchain, designed to create a vast, user-managed virtual universe. The platform allows creators to build planets and develop new utilities on top of existing assets, fostering a decentralized environment for social interaction and gaming. With a focus on minimizing restrictions and maximizing freedom, Spacetime Meta enables participants to live and interact in a persistent digital world. It serves as a hub for NFT communities to meet, collaborate, and define the future of digital residency and user-led governance.
content.meta: Spacetime Meta is a user-owned Cardano virtual universe for digital world-building and gaming. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
